positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Projects Associate (Software Engineer)
positions.description:
•	Deployed to end-client 3M Company for the full duration of employment.
•	Modernized 3M’s external data management solution by employing cloud-based infrastructure, graph databases, and full-stack applications, enabling smooth data migration operations from their legacy solution in the future.
•	Constructed NodeJS-based application data management APIs, thus overhauling the legacy backend.
•	Implemented data storage strategies that ensured residency compliance in accordance with international data regulations.
•	Interfaced with other internal teams and senior leadership at 3M and integrated their applications with the solution.
•	Rapidly established a duplicate solution for 3M’s spinoff Solventum, which was implemented shortly following company launch.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Deployment · Amazon Neptune · AWS CloudFormation · Technical Writing · Postman API · Amazon CloudWatch · Debugging · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JSON · Azure Active Directory B2C · Code Review · Atlassian Jira · Amazon ECS · Communication · GitHub · Agile Software Development · Documentation · Software Documentation · Sails.js · Node.js · REST APIs · Agile Project Management · Okta · Apache Tinkerpop Gremlin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Associate: Java Full-Stack + Angular -  4/22/19-9/30/19
Software Engineer deployed to Cognizant: 10/1/19 - 5/13/22

•	Underwent intensive career software development training, having trained in various technologies under the Java-Angular full-stack.
•	With a team of 10 other associate developers, produced significant contribution to an in-progress enterprise-level project designed to store and archive coding projects developed by associates while in training, advancing the project towards future deployment to production.
•	Deployed to Cognizant following completion of training for the remainder of employment.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Deployment · Postman API · Debugging · Angular · JSON · TypeScript · Communication · GitHub · Software Infrastructure · Agile Software Development · Node.js · Core Java · Oracle SQL · Agile Project Management · Spring Boot

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
-Received and stocked over $15,000 in general merchandise on a weekly basis
-Operated Point-of-Sale systems and assisted in maintaining accuracy in cashwrap operations
-Implemented loss prevention tactics on high-value goods and reduced average inventory losses to less than $100 per week

positions.title: Reserve Officer
positions.description:
Inactive Reservist
-Led the Reserve support center’s volunteer training unit, consisting of nearly 30 sailors.
-Provided weekly presentations and general military training for sailors undergoing reserve indoctrination.

positions.title: Bookseller
positions.locationName: Georgia Institute of Technology - Atlanta, GA
positions.description:
General Merchandiser
- Maintained stock on school and dorm supplies, graduation regalia and gifts, clothing and emblematics in a high store-volume envrionment (over $10 million).

Textbooks Assistant 
- Assisted in general and athletic textbook rush and buyback operations.

Cashier and Vending 
- Performed cash wrap transactions in general store operation and campus-related events.

positions.title: Submarine Officer, Squadron Operations Assistant
positions.description:
-Coordinated Midshipmen summer training operations for a submarine squadron.
-Led a division of submarine propulsion mechanics of about 15 sailors.
-Led a division of submarine sonar technicians of about 15 sailors.
-Commanded submarine propulsion and operational watch teams.
-Held a Top Secret security clearance.

positions.title: Nuclear Pipeline Student
positions.description:
-Trained on nuclear fundamentals, propulsion principles, and integrated operations.
-Applied theory to practice onboard prototype vessels containing reactor plants while exercising operational command and control and safety with a seven-to-ten-person propulsion plant watch team.

positions.title: Bookseller, Student Supervisor
positions.locationName: University of South Florida - Tampa, FL
positions.description:
-Led a team of as many as 20 fellow student booksellers during semi-annual textbook sales rush seasons without supervision from senior management.
-Led a team of as many as 15 fellow student booksellers and cashiers during semi-annual textbook buyback seasons without supervision from senior management.
-Stocked over 100,000 new and used textbooks for sale per year.
-Facilitated textbook searches and special order placements for college students and faculty.
-Prepared and packaged textbooks for pickup and shipping for textbook orders placed online.
-Coordinated the efficient placement of overstocked textbooks.
-Prepared and boxed textbooks for returns to over 20 publishers and distributors.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Small Group Leadership · Team Leadership · Stock Control
